notes.title: Balance, Bug Fixes, Art, and Audio
notes.notes:
[h1]Balance updates[/h1]

Construct Distribution
[list]
[*]When starting the game you will now initially only encounter Normal (green) Constructs until you clear the forest zones. When the coastal portal has opened, Enhanced (blue) Constructs will begin to appear in the forest zones and beyond, the same will happen with Elite (red) Constructs when you clear the coastal zones. We think this will provide a better difficulty curve as well as keep the game fresh and more interesting the more new players progress. For players that have already unlocked both tracks you will notice a more varied mix of enemies earlier on in each run. You will also encounter more (quantity) Enhanced Constructs in the coastal zones and Elite Constructs in the mountain zones.
[/list]

[h1]Enemy Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Rebalanced enemy health
[*]Enhanced Slimes now fling their spike balls toward the player
[*]Enhanced Chargers spawn less spike balls in their trail
[*]Changed spike ball spread for Enhanced Automatons
[*]Elite Slimes fire their bullets toward the player
[*]Elite Slimes are now the same size as other slimes
[*]Elite Chargers now fire their bullets before charging
[*]Elite Floaters now fire 4 shots instead of 8, their shot angle changes each shot
[/list]



[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug preventing doors from opening after dying to “The Challenger” shrine
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a soft lock when speaking to Guardsman Ned
[*]Fixed a bug preventing dungeon wanderer npc buffs from carrying over to the next zone.
[*]Fixed a bug with the Colossal Deathbloom and Ghastly Lurker where they would become unkillable. 
[/list]

[h1]Treasure[/h1]
[list]
[*]Lootboxes now take the number of items available into account when rolling for lootbox type when dropped.
[/list]

[h1]Art[/h1]
[list]
[*]The artwork for Recluse has been updated.
[*]New attack animations for Normal and Enhanced Automatons
[*]New art for Normal Automatons
[*]New art for the loot station
[*]Coastal and mountain plants appear around the starting portal when their respective areas have been unlocked
[/list]

[h1]Audio[/h1]
[list]
[*]New temporary audio for the “Decrepit Foundry” Boss
[*]Menu sound effects reimplemented
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*]When defeating a boss or Challenger shrine without getting hit, you will receive a “Perfect!” notification in the top right of the screen.
[*]Updated armor select tutorial to properly represent its new functionality
[*]Updated art for burning effects
[*]Various dialogue tweaks
[*]Edited armor buff tooltips for cohesiveness
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update 3.9
notes.notes:
[h1]Content Update 3.9[/h1]

Hey Everybody! We have a pretty big update for you all, so let’s get right into it!

[h1]What’s New?[/h1]

[b]Overcharged - New Enemy Modifier:[/b] Overcharged enemies move faster, and shoot faster projectiles. Overcharged enemies have electricity surrounding them

[b]New Enemy:[/b] Stout walker golems that follow the player and do a spin attack when close

[b]Enhanced Enemy tier update:[/b] The bombs enhanced enemies (the blue enemies) drop or shoot have been replaced with spike balls that can harm you on contact. Spike balls linger for a while before shrinking away.

[b]Currency and Merchants:[/b] Enemies now drop currency (Cores) that can be spent at merchant rooms in dungeons.
Health merchant
Shield merchant
Cartographer, pay to reveal the map.
Tonic merchant, provides a random stat boost

[b]New Weapons:[/b] 27 new weapons have been added

[b]Improved weapon comparison and stats screens.[/b] 
Stats are now more accurately represented and easier to understand at a glance. Player buffs can be viewed along with your current weapon’s stats in the pause menu 

[b]Weapon Viewer:[/b] You can now view all weapons up close by activating the rug at the entrance to the storeroom in the weapon building

[b]New Armor:[/b] 2 new armor sets have been added, as well as a misc. Hat

Interacting with a few items in town can change the player character’s skin color

[h1]Rebalancing[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased base player movement speed
[*]Increased base player damage
[*]Increased base enemy movement speed
[*]Increased base enemy bullet speed
[*]Reduced chances of armor spawning from boss chests
[*]Removed health/armor crates from weapon rooms
[*]Only 1 health/armor crate will appear in hallways per dungeon
[*]Improved dungeon generation, dungeons should have less long hallways and should be tighter overall 
[*]Weapons have been separated into ranks (D, C, B, A, S)
[*]Weapon rebalancing
[*]Roller Bomb enemies now damage other enemies when exploding
[*]Health and Armor exchange shrines have been reduced to 3 uses per shrine
[/list]
[h1]Art[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated weapon storage room
[*]New building interior location to equip armor, works similar to the existing dyes building
[*]Visual tweaks to the dyes building interior
[*]Updated weapon icons seen when a new weapon is unlocked
[*]Updated armor icons seen when equipping armor
[*]Updates to the layout and design of some Hub buildings
[*]Additional portal particle effects
[*]Updated various equip stations tutorial text
[/list]
[h1]Sound[/h1]

We’ve recently been overhauling the systems behind how our audio works, in the future this will make audio work easier to do. But for now we have also lost some effects that we’ll need to reimplement in the future. This may also introduce some general audio quirks to the game. However we didn’t want a few small hiccups to delay what we think is a pretty substantial update that improves the game dramatically.
[list]
[*]Improved weapon swing sounds and timing
[*]Slimes now make a gooey sound when hit
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Roller enemies no longer leave an invisible hitbox where they died
[*]Some UI tweaks and fixes
[/list]


If you’ve been enjoying the game please consider writing a positive review over on our store page, they really help us out. If you haven't been enjoying the game or think something in it could be better, tell us over on the forums, we’re always interested in what people have to say about the current state of the game and how it could be improved!

notes.title: Content Update 3.5
notes.notes:
[h1]What’s New?[/h1]

[h1]New Enemies[/h1]
[list][*]3 new high tier enemies have been added to the game that can appear in regular battle rooms. They start appearing in dungeons after the Ancient Assembler boss fight.
[*]1 special new enemy that you should keep your eyes peeled for ;)
[/list]

[h1]Rebalancing[/h1]
[list][*]Combat has been rebalanced to be more fast paced
[*]Health crates no longer appear in hallways[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list][*]Complete UI overhaul of both the Armor and Dye select stations. It should be a lot easier and faster to get yourself looking how you’d like
[*]Removed the Weapon select UI near the weapon shop, the starting weapon select is now found near the portal to the dungeon, where they are picked up as you would other weapons in the dungeon
[*]Update map icon for weapon rooms[/list]


[h1]Art[/h1][list]
[*]New art for the starting room and boss door rooms in each dungeon
[*]Additional art for the Ghastly Lurker
[*]Updated specularity for all armor and weapons
[*]You can now enter the weapon gallery, weapons appear in the store room as you unlock them from loot chests
[*]You can now enter the dye shop, activate the dressing stand to change dyes[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed slowdowns that could occur during the Monstrous Borer’s tunneling attack
[*]The Dragon Snapper can now be pushed out of the way if it’s blocking the exit portal
[*]The Ancient Dungeoneering Sword and Berserker’s Greatsword models now properly appear in weapon pickup rooms.[/list]


As always we’d love to hear any feedback you guys have, and thanks for playing!

notes.title: Content Update 3 - Weapon Discovery & The Forgotten Coast!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! We are happy to announce the release of our latest major content update. Major changes have been rolled out in this update, and we are eager to hear your feedback. Please read though this explanation of changes, and as always feel free to contact us on the forums if you have questions or concerns!

[h1]Branching Paths[/h1]

With this update we are introducing branching paths to the dungeon! As a new form of progression, players who can manage to beat the current Forest Track will unlock a new portal to take after beating the second dungeon boss. This portal leads to an all new advanced dungeon track with more difficult enemies and unique bosses! 

The branching paths concept allows us to add more dungeon content in the future, and will contribute to the Player’s story within the world. With that said, the ‘Tombs’ dungeon has been locked away for the time being, and will return larger and more daunting than ever as a challenging “endgame” dungeon that will test even the most advanced Rogues players!

[h1]Coastal Track[/h1]

With this update we are introducing the Coastal Track! These new areas boast a more tropical climate and feature wide and open areas compared to the forest track. You’ll first trek through a Deserted Port where large sand dunes have started building upon the old fractured walls. Moving forward leads to the Mangal Backwater, a wooden pier that was built between dense croppings of mangroves. Finally you’ll enter the Ginfall Mines, an ancient mining facility dedicated to harvesting precious gemstones has been recently abandoned due to it becoming too dangerous.

Once unlocked, you’ll be free to explore the tropical coast!

This New Track Includes
[list]
[*]Three New Dungeons
[*]Three New Bosses
[/list]

[h1]Weapon Update[/h1]

Arguably the biggest change to Rogues Like Us to date, the weapon system has received a complete overhaul, which drastically alters dungeon exploration as well as  the way players progress in the game.

Moving closer to the spirit of Rogue like games, we’ve decided to remove both the weapon collection and weapon progression systems in favor of a new discovery system. Players will always start a run with one of three starting weapons, but are able to find new weapons in the dungeon as they explore. Weapons found in the dungeon will have randomized stats that scale based on the area they are found in, meaning the power of each weapon you find will be appropriate for the dungeon, and no two weapons will be exactly the same.

Shrines can still be found in the dungeon, altering the player’s stats, rather than a weapon’s, when you interact with them. This means any positive effects (as well as negative ones) will stick with the player even after they find a new weapon.


Mage Stones (weapon upgrades) are no longer added to weapons by the player, and are therefore no longer collected. Likewise, the experience “souls” and shards currency that was previously used in upgrading weapons has been removed for the time being, though it may return later as part of a different system.  

We hope to make each individual run more memorable, have players experience more weapons, and have a more interesting experience overall. Before, most players were pick a single weapon, with a certain loadout of gems, and never try out other builds. Now, it’ll be easier to experiment with a variety of weapons and enchantments within a single run.

[h1]Loot Update[/h1]

Due to the major overhaul of the weapon systems, Loot has received a much needed overhaul as well. Treasure rooms in dungeons have been replaced with weapon rooms, making boss battles the current sole source for loot chests. Instead of the previous rarity system, loot has been broken into four categories, each equally likely to be found.

[list]
[*]Dye Chest: Contains a dye color that is permanently available at the Dye Station for use with player armor
[*]Enchantment Chest: Contains one of several weapon enchantments (previously runestones). Once collected, these enchantments will have a chance of appearing on weapons in the dungeon.
[*]Armor Chest: Contains one new armor piece from a random set (these are unique, players will never receive duplicates)
[*]Weapon Chest: Contains one new Weapon. Once collected, the weapon will have a chance of appearing in the dungeon.

Weapons found in the dungeon will have randomized stats that scale based on the area they are found in, meaning the power of each weapon you find will be appropriate for the dungeon, and no two weapons will be exactly the same.

Shrines can still be found in the dungeon, altering the player’s stats, rather than a weapon’s, when you interact with them. This means any positive effects (as well as negative ones) will stick with the player even after they find a new weapon.


Mage Stones (weapon upgrades) are no longer added to weapons by the player, and are therefore no longer collected. Likewise, the experience “souls” and shards currency that was previously used in upgrading weapons has been removed for the time being, though it may return later as part of a different system.  

We hope to make each individual run more memorable, have players experience more weapons, and have a more interesting experience overall. Before, most players were pick a single weapon, with a certain loadout of gems, and never try out other builds. Now, it’ll be easier to experiment with a variety of weapons and enchantments within a single run.

[h1]Loot Update[/h1]

Due to the major overhaul of the weapon systems, Loot has received a much needed overhaul as well. Treasure rooms in dungeons have been replaced with weapon rooms, making boss battles the current sole source for loot chests. Instead of the previous rarity system, loot has been broken into four categories, each equally likely to be found.

[list]
[*]Dye Chest: Contains a dye color that is permanently available at the Dye Station for use with player armor
[*]Enchantment Chest: Contains one of several weapon enchantments (previously runestones). Once collected, these enchantments will have a chance of appearing on weapons in the dungeon.
[*]Armor Chest: Contains one new armor piece from a random set (these are unique, players will never receive duplicates)
[*]Weapon Chest: Contains one new Weapon. Once collected, the weapon will have a chance of appearing in the dungeon.

notes.title: Art Overhaul: Content Update 2
notes.notes:
[img]https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=0BwpXWru1d1pAQnJKdktnTHdSWWc[/img]

[b]Hey there Rogues,[/b]

Development has been in full swing and we’ve received a lot of great feedback since our last big content update. We’re doing our best to keep to our bi-weekly game updates, however, we needed to take bit of extra time with this update due to its size. With this game update, we are doing a large art overhaul, along with other fixes, general improvements, and some new content.

[h1]Art Overhaul[/h1]
The most notable change is that each dungeon now has a unique color palette. Individual dungeons should now feel cohesive and unified. Also, there is a shift in tone as the player progresses through dungeons, starting in warm and familiar territory and moving into cold and foreign areas.

Lighting and Shaders have been significantly overhauled. The old shaders had several limitations when it came to lighting, giving us little room to adjust lighting from scene to scene. Our new shaders correct this issue, giving us much more freedom with lighting color, direction, ambiance, etc. The overhauled dungeons reflect this change, with vastly different lighting from level to level.

[h1]New Weapons[/h1]
[list]
[*]Katana - Rare Light Sword
[*]Claymore - Rare Medium Sword
[*]Crescent Moon Axe - Rare Medium Axe
[*]Tenderizer - Rare Heavy Warhammer

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27611810/08edf726473d9a8a627754bb0a2eadfa3056d9ff.png[/img]

[/list]

[h1]New Armor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Crusader Set
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27611810/deea71ca851ef666cb71f9e2b741ff62db18d596.png[/img]

[h1]New Shrines[/h1]
[list]
[*]Souls Shrine - You can now find a shrine in the dungeons that gives buffs at the cost of souls. 
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes / General Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]DASH CANCELLING -  You can now dash mid swing or mid aoe to cancel your attack.
[*]“Rune Available” notifications should be more noticeable.
[*]Die Boss laser attack redone to be more dangerous.
[*]Option added to turn off screen shake.
[*]Dashing through breakables should be more consistent.
[*]Fixed an issue where slowed enemies would be persist through death.
[*]Slow passive now affects all enemies properly.
[*]Tree opacities in the Dark Forest should now be more consistent.
[*]Souls counter properly updates after interacting with certain shrines.
[*]Game can no longer be launched without the Steam client open.
[*]Slimes should be a bit shinier.
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update 1 - Shrines
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27611810/f2563e2cd21b9e78104d8675b3308fbf016e8e21.png[/img]

[b]Hey there Rogues,[/b]

Our first two week sprint since launch has finally come to a close, and we have quite a bit of new content added into the game! We went through all the feedback and what was widely requested was something to add a bit more depth and randomness to the gameplay, a way for your gameplay and stats to change in ways you may not expect (both good and bad). To that end, we have added Shrines to the game!

[h1]New Feature: Shrines[/h1]

As you adventure through the dungeons, you will occasionally find rooms with one of seven types of Shrines. Activating them will grant you a buff, debuff, or random effect based on the type of Shrine and how lucky you are. Some Shrines are free to activate and others may cost you something important. The choice is yours whether to accept your fate or turn away!

We as a team feel that these Shrines fill a much needed gap in the variation of gameplay. Before when you’d enter a dungeon, you were directly testing your loadout against the dungeon itself with no variation throughout. It felt static and a bit repetitive at times. Now, the Shrines can completely flip your gameplay upside down (for good and for bad), and save runs that previously would have been lost. You may even find new playstyles that you didn’t even think were possible before.

[h1]Camera Angle Change[/h1]

From the feedback we received, some players were having a difficult time getting an initial handle on controlling the character in combat. We realized after reviewing some options that the camera angle we chose was at a skew so that you actually moved faster in one direction than the other. We increased the angle so you should be able to better control the character from a visual standpoint, as well as have a better sense of maneuverability between enemies, walls, and projectiles.

For those of you who have been playing the game quite frequently, it will take you a few levels to get used to, but we know you will appreciate the new angle and the information it gives you.

[h1]Quality of Life / Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Enemies have updated models to better differentiate themselves apart from color
[*]More lively NPCs in the Hub
[*]Option added to rotate the minimap
[*]Option added to always have the minimap on
[*]Smoothing added to camera movements
[*]Option added to increase or decrease the maximum amount of shrapnel from destroyed enemies and objects that can be allowed in the game
[*]Option added to disable post processing effects
[*]Option added to change shadow quality
[*]Player, Enemies, and Projectiles are now visible behind objects
[*]Added a confirmation window for returning to the hub from the dungeon
[*]Changed the font of dialogue
[*]Added unique camera angles to match each boss fight
[*]Minimap now automatically turns off while in combat and turns back on after
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where certain enemies wouldn’t show the stun and slow icons
[*]Fixed multiple UI navigation issues
[*]Fixed an issue where the equipped shoulder armor piece and dyes were not being saved properly
[*]Fixed an issue where pickups would land on top of portals
[*]Fixed an issue where pickups blocked bullets
[*]Fixed an issue where explosions destroyed bullets
[*]Fixed an issue where camera looking was framerate dependent
[*]Moved tutorial check to steam cloud data
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27611810/1e08d63f0ea15d8aaeee43063b3b67074f723eb2.png[/img]

Hey there Rogues,

We’re pushing a quick patch today; we’ve gotten a lot of great feedback so far and wanted to quickly address some of the more pressing bugs and quality of life improvements that were asked for.

As we move forward with development, we will be working hard to release new content every two weeks. We want to keep you all in the loop every step of the way, so make sure to check back here frequently for updates. We also [url=https://www.twitch.tv/oddbytegames]stream development[/url] every Thursday at 6pm EST, so drop by and check out what new content we’re working on. Thank you all for your support and feedback so far, keep it coming!

Patch notes below:

[h1]Patch 0.1.1[/h1]

[h1]Quality of Life / Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Overlay Map can now toggle between three modes: Off, Mini Map, Full Map
[*]Crates in Aberrant rooms drop more pickups
[*]PS4 Button Icons option added to settings
[*]Currently selected element in UI should overall be more visible
[*]The Hub should feel a bit more alive
[*]Overlay Map automatically turns off while in combat, and turns on again when out of combat
[*]Fixed various typos
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an Issue where the AoE Size gemstone was multiplying the effect on each use until the game crashed
[*]Moved the tutorial completion check to steam cloud data so it can’t be exploited across multiple devices
[*]Fixed an Issue where Q and E wouldn’t swap gemstone pages in the Weapon Select
[*]Fixed an issue where pickups would get stuck on objects out of the player’s reach
[*]Fixed an issue where you couldn’t equip a gemstone into certain slots on a weapon
[*]Fixed an issue where chests would bounce off the map
[*]Fixed an issue where arrow keys wouldn’t pan the camera
[*]Fixed an issue where right stick wouldn’t pan the camera on Mac
[/list]

[h1]Fix for using a PS4 controller[/h1]

PS4 controllers are not natively supported yet, it is going to take some time. But luckily there is a way around it with Steam’s big picture mode. You can follow the steps below
[list]
[*]Launch steam big picture mode, it is the controller icon in the top left of your steam window.
[*]Go to settings. It is a cog wheel at the top right of big picture mode.
[*]Go to controller settings
[*]Then check the PS4 configuration support checkbox. Steam will ask you to disconnect any PS4 controllers so do that.
[*]Then launch Rogues Like US through big picture mode and your PS4 controller should work!
[/list]

You only have to do this once, then you can launch the game like normal from now on.

Also, you can switch your ingame buttons to look like PS4 buttons if you go to our controls options in game and switch the Button Images mode to PS4.

With the early access release being this coming Friday, we here at oddByte thought we'd make a quick update post to let you know what we will be up to for the next week.

For the most part we will be polishing up this store page, finishing our release trailer, and fixing some smaller bugs in the game.
